title: 4.11 Unit 4 Review
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
goal: Review Unit 4 through fresh scenes: rooms and who is in them, furniture, where things are, there is and there are, the morning routine and daily actions, Do you...? questions, days and the time. No new language.
grammar_function: This is the + room; The grandfather is in the living room.; there is / there are; in, on, under, next to; Where is...?; I + daily action; first, then, every day; Do you ...? Yes, I do.; What day is it today? Today is ...; What time is it? It is ... o'clock.
speaking_outcome: Say six Unit 4 lines aloud across rooms, object location, existence, routine and time.
